`RustBEARS` provides drop-in compatibility with `BioGeoBEARS` (all 545 R exports retained) alongside exact extant tip-survival conditioning, endpoint-conditioned Uniformization stochastic mapping, and five frequentist uncertainty quantification tools.

## 1. Fitting Survival-Conditioned DEC and DEC+J Models

The example below uses the bundled 19-tip Hawaiian *Psychotria* dataset:

```{r fit, eval=FALSE}
library(RustBEARS)

run <- define_BioGeoBEARS_run(
  trfn = system.file("extdata/Psychotria_5.2_ultrametric.newick", package = "RustBEARS"),
  geogfn = system.file("extdata/Psychotria_geog.data", package = "RustBEARS"),
  max_range_size = 4,
  calc_ancprobs = TRUE,
  print_optim = FALSE
)

# Enable extant tip-survival conditioning with a normalized uniform non-null root prior
run$likelihood_conditioning <- "tip_survival"
run$root_prior <- define_root_prior("uniform_nonnull")
run$num_cores_to_use <- 1L
run <- readfiles_BioGeoBEARS_run(run)

dec <- bears_optim_run(run)

runj <- run
runj$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["j", "type"] <- "free"
runj$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table["j", c("init", "est")] <- 0.01
decj <- bears_optim_run(runj)
```

Three likelihood formulations are available:
- `"legacy_unconditioned"` (default for backward compatibility): retains the historical unconditioned `BioGeoBEARS` score.
- `"tip_survival"`: conditions observed extant tip ranges on every sampled tip surviving to the present with a non-empty range.
- `"unconditional_complete"`: completes null-to-null cladogenetic transmission over all $S^N$ outcomes (requires `run$allow_null_tips <- TRUE`).

By default, `RustBEARS` uses 64-bit IEEE-754 double precision (`StrictF64`). To emulate historical 32-bit mixed-precision rounding points, set `options(RustBEARS.precision = "LegacyF32")`.

## 2. Profile Intervals, Parametric Bootstrap LRT, and Model Averaging

```{r inference, eval=FALSE}
# Profile likelihood confidence intervals (handles boundary optima and flags flat upper ridges)
intervals <- profile_ci(dec, params = c("d", "e"))
print(intervals)

# Parametric bootstrap likelihood-ratio test with resumable checkpointing
test <- bootstrap_lrt(
  dec, decj,
  n_boot = 199L,
  checkpoint_file = "psychotria-bootstrap.rds",
  seedval = 42L
)
print(test)

# Akaike model-averaged ancestral probabilities and stochastic maps
average <- model_average(list(DEC = dec, DECJ = decj), criterion = "AICc", num_maps = 500L, seedval = 42L)
```

## 3. Uniformization Stochastic Mapping and Posterior Tree Propagation

```{r trees, eval=FALSE}
# Fast endpoint-conditioned Uniformization stochastic mapping
maps <- runBSM(
  dec, NULL,
  bsm_engine = "native_whole_tree",
  seedval = 42L,
  target_rmcse = 0.05,
  min_maps = 200L,
  batch_size = 200L,
  max_maps = 2000L
)
precision <- bsm_diagnostics(maps, tree_target = "fixed_sample")

# Propagate parameter, model, and topological uncertainty across posterior trees
multiple <- fit_over_trees(
  run,
  trees = "posterior_trees.newick",
  models = c("DEC", "DEC+J"),
  likelihood_conditioning = "tip_survival",
  bsm_maps_per_tree = 200L,
  checkpoint_file = "tree-fits.rds"
)
```

## Supported Scope

`tip_survival` and the uncertainty modules support DEC, DIVALIKE, BAYAREALIKE, and `+J` models, spatial/environmental/area modifiers (`+x`, `+n`, `+w`, `+u`, `areas_adjacency`), and multi-stratum time slicing (`timeperiods`) with chronologically monotone area emergence (`areas_allowed`). Fossil tips, non-monotone submergence masks, and trait-coupled models remain available under `"legacy_unconditioned"`.
